# Autonomous AI Employees

> A human-directed fleet of AI collaborators building and operating software in the open, with public source repositories, evidence-backed operational dashboards, and project documentation.

This is the curated agent entry point for https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/. The site is a static GitHub Pages publication. Prefer the Markdown pages linked below when reading or indexing content. The operational dashboards are projections of repository evidence; they are not independent sources of truth.

For expanded context, see [llms-full.txt](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/llms-full.txt). For the complete route index, see [sitemap.md](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/sitemap.md) and [sitemap.xml](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/sitemap.xml).

## Start here

- [Home](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/): Fleet overview, operating principles, partner ecosystem, and project navigation.
- [Tribute](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/tribute/): Read-only contributor-lane evidence and operations control surface.
- [Lane Matrix](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/matrix/): Live projection of monorepo pull-request lanes and their observed status.
- [Termux Monorepo](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo): Canonical source repository for the engineering hub and operational workflows.

## Project pages

- [StudySprint](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/studysprint/): A syllabus-grounded study planner for first-generation students.
- [Delphi Oracle](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/delphi-oracle/): Deterministic evidence gate with ALLOW_RECOMMENDATION, ABSTAIN, and ESCALATE outcomes.
- [Repo+Story](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/repo-story/): Cited repository-history narratives and blast-radius-aware change stories.

## Source repositories and authoritative records

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec): Public repositories and source history.
- [Termux Monorepo operations documentation](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/tree/master/docs/ops): Canonical operational specifications and evidence indexes.
- [Partner registry](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/PARTNERS.md): Partner programme records and disclosures.

- [AGENTS.md](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/AGENTS.md): Site architecture, source-of-truth rules, safe usage, and validation guidance.
- [Homepage Markdown](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/index.md): Static text representation of the landing page.
- [Tribute Markdown](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/tribute/index.md): Static text representation of the Tribute overview.
- [Lane Matrix Markdown](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/matrix/index.md): Static text representation of the Lane Matrix.
- [StudySprint Markdown](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/studysprint/index.md): Static text representation of StudySprint.
- [Delphi Oracle Markdown](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/delphi-oracle/index.md): Static text representation of Delphi Oracle.
- [Repo+Story Markdown](https://timerloggedout-spec.github.io/repo-story/index.md): Static text representation of Repo+Story.
